job.prompt: Create a realistic B2B hero image for a private-label and OEM tool program offering. Show professional tool packaging and branding: blister-packed hand tools, a custom-branded toolkit case, and neatly arranged packaged product lines suggesting white-label manufacturing capability. The visual should communicate brand flexibility, packaging professionalism, and export readiness. Restrained backgrounds, premium packaging aesthetic, no discount retail look. Suitable for a manufacturer pitching to distributors and store brands.
